greet.text: Far enough. Hands where I can see them. ...You're the one who's been following the light. Mirela's by the fire. Walk slow.

choices.text: (Outlaw) Easy. I'm on the same notice board as you.

who.text: The Thornwood Free. Free of taxes, free of licences, free of the garrison. Mostly free of food, lately.

outlaw.text: Ha. Then you know the rules: don't steal from the pot, and don't bring the garrison home with you.
